description: Steady-state power map for direct-cycle BWR (no steam generator)

unit.name: Generic 3300 MWth / 1100 MWe BWR (BWR/6 class)
unit.source: Todreas & Kazimi (2012), Nuclear Systems, 2nd ed., CRC Press; GE BWR/6 reference

P_thermal_mw.note: Reactor core thermal power at full load

P_electric_mw.note: Net electrical output at full load

T_steam_c.note: Saturated steam temperature at core outlet (~70 bar)

PLR_min.note: Minimum stable PLR (BWR has limited load following)

h_fg_kjkg.note: Latent heat of vaporization at 70 bar

cp_water_kjkgk.note: Specific heat of liquid water at ~250 degC

m_dot_steam_nominal_kgs.note: Nominal steam mass flow rate at full power

PLR_linear_derate_below.note: Below this PLR, efficiency derated linearly
